perks.name: Bad Dreams
perks.description: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 3 Elementally-Debuffed Enemy Kills:
Spawns an Orb of Power that grants ?% Super Energy.
No cooldown between Orbs?

perks.name: Dream-Devourer
perks.description: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Devour for 6+3 seconds.

While Devour is active:
20?% Damage Resist against Combatants.

item.name: Heavy Handed
item.description: Your powered melee final blows create Orbs of Power.
item.exact:
On Powered Melee Kill:
Spawns an Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.
Can trigger alongside Firepower if equipped after it.
From left to right order.
